messages:
maya (api): quick poll: central gateway for all internal APIs vs per-service front-proxy? we need to consider quotas, rollout UX, and console noise.
ori (platform): team vote for per-service front-proxies. faster local canaries and less central bottleneck.
jo (product): worried about console noise. customers don't want 1000 route rows. need aggregated rollups and a searchable catalog.
li (devex): can we standardize a canonical route id so telemetry can be grouped even if routing is delegated? that solves UI concerns.
maya (api): propose hybrid: runtime decision at front-proxy, control-plane owns canonical catalog + rollout configs and global policies. proxies emit canonical headers.
sam (sre): ops note: single gateway caused large blast radius in past incidents. distributed proxies + central backstop for billing caps sounds safer.
li (devex): telemetry contract: every proxy MUST emit header X-RW-Route: org:service:route_key and X-RW-Rollout: primary|canary|shadow. console stitches by org/service.
config-bot: header X-RW-Route added to header whitelist (schema v1).
ori (platform): quotas: option 1 = sync central check (consistency) vs option 2 = local token-bucket synced periodically (scalable). leaning token-bucket + central billing backstop.
jo (product): agree with token-bucket if UI shows last-sync and staleness indicator. customers should see eventual consistency.
maya (api): protos on the wire for catalog + a JSON editor in UI to author entries that compile to proto.
li (devex): rollout UX: canary percent slider per route, auto-fallback when error_rate > threshold, and one-click rollback. proxies must accept streaming config (gRPC).
sam (sre): retention proposal: per-route metrics 365d, traces 90d, logs 30d. longer retention behind paid tiers.
maya (api): action items: maya -> route-id spec PR, ori -> token-bucket sync doc, li -> console prototype, sam -> SLOs/retention doc. default decision: delegated proxies + unified control-plane for catalog/telemetry/backstop unless major objections by EOD.
li (devex): :thumbsup:
jo (product): :thumbsup:
sam (sre): :thumbsup: thanks, will review PR.
